## introduction
* hardware: MBP 2023 with M2 Max & 32GB RAM
* python environments managed using `pyenv` and the `virtualenvwrapper` but
for python based cli I use `pipx`. See [here](https://gist.github.com/ohjho/8e2556d786b132d724b3914728c7c82f)
for details on full setup

## The Toolchain

* docker: `brew install --cask docker`
    * you will need to follow [this guide here](https://stackoverflow.com/a/43365425)
    * and you do want the cask version because the [official version for Mac is a GUI](https://stackoverflow.com/a/40523608)... i.e. there are no headless version
    * my [docker cheatsheet](https://gist.github.com/ohjho/af86af1c1dfab4979f6d0543000351cd)

* [macmon](https://medium.com/@vladkens/mac-usage-monitor-in-terminal-meet-macmon-3a3391995224):
    * TUI for monitoring resource use on Apple's ARM architecture MacBook
    * like a much better version of `htop`
    * install: `brew update && brew install macmon`
* [Sequel-Ace](https://github.com/Sequel-Ace/Sequel-Ace?tab=readme-ov-file):
    * MySQL management for macOS
    * install: `brew update && brew install --cask sequel-ace`
